'''Primitive Manducaters''', known internally as '''Hull''', are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Primitive Manducaters are spawned after a successful merging between 4 [[Moving Flesh]], through the [[Evolution System]].
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 3, from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 2|Ubiquitous Development Level 2]] through [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Level 4]], with a spawnweight of 15.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawned by 4 [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mobs]] stored into a [[Stage III Dispatcher|Stage III]] or [[Stage IV Dispatcher|IV Dispatcher]].
*Spawned by a level 4 or higher [[Scent System|Scent]].
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when an [[Adapted Manducater]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Primitive Manducaters are high-damage, stealth-focused melee combatants.

*Primitive Manducaters' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
*They can become almost completely invisible when above 70% of their maximum health.  While being in this state, their speed is greatly decreased but their damage is doubled and their target becomes immobile for a small while. Their invisibility is removed if the Manducater attacks or takes damage.  This ability has a 15-second cooldown.
*Primitive Manducaters has a chance of blocking incoming damage, nullifying it.
*Primitive Manducaters can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
*Primitive Manducaters can dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
*Primitive Manducaters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 1, with a 60 ticks cooldown and 1 Block range.
*On death, Primitive Manducaters have a chance to explode, releasing Primitive Remains and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and COTH.
*If a Primitive Manducater gets 10 kills it will evolve into an [[Adapted Manducater]].
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherPriManducater.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Primitive Manducaters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.{{Properties
|tier=Primitive
|OrbEffectsMobs=Hunger II (00:15)
|OrbEffectsSelf=Invisibility (00:20)<ref>The duration lengthens for each mob within the Orb's radius.</ref>
}}

=== ''Post Death'' ===
*On death, Primitive Manducaters have a chance to explode into [[Remains|Primitive Remains]], leaving behind a effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|Call of the Hive]].
** If at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Primitive Manducaters will become [[Moving Flesh]] upon death instead.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*Manducaters are also known as '''Hull''' in the Mod Files.
*"Manducate" is an archaic English word meaning to chew or eat.
*In-game text is inconsistent with the spelling of its name, with items calling it "Manducater" with an E, and the subtitles calling it "Manducator" with an O.
